title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: What an Amended Declaration May Change and Its Limits
content:
## Clause

A Dangerous Goods Acceptance declaration is amended only by a fresh declaration signed by the shipper, and nobody but the shipper can sign it. The amendment may alter only those particulars the category lists as changeable. Changing the IMDG class, or any particular outside that list, cannot be done by amendment: the application has to be withdrawn and a new one lodged.

Once the goods are approved, an amendment is open only in categories that allow amendment after approval, and the amendment sends the acceptance back to review.

## Limits every amendment must respect

| Limit | Content |
|---|---|
| Deadline | signed no later than the category's amendment cut-off, counted in hours back from the cargo cut-off of the booking's sailing |
| Number | the acceptance may take no more than the category's maximum of signed amendments, counted from the signed amendment declarations already on the declaration file |
| Weight | the declared gross weight may move up or down by no more than the category's percentage of the weight held immediately prior to this amendment |
| Containers | the count may go up only in categories that permit an increase |
| Sailing allotment | every amendment stays within the customer's allotment on the sailing |

**Deadline mechanics.** The amendment deadline is the cargo cut-off time recorded on the booking less the category's amendment cut-off in hours, reckoned as whole 60-minute hours in the local time of the port of loading. An amendment signed exactly at the deadline is accepted.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

The limits below are invented for illustration.

- *Weight.* Prior declared weight 20000 kg, permitted change 5 percent: 21000 kg and 19000 kg are both within the limit; 21001 kg is not.
- *Number.* Maximum of 2 signed amendments: with one already signed, a second is possible; with two already signed, a third is not.
- *Deadline.* Cargo cut-off 2026-09-02 at 10:00 local, cut-off of 36 hours: deadline 2026-08-31 at 22:00; signing at 22:00 is accepted, at 22:05 it is not.

## Points of judgement

**A shipper wants to correct the class it declared. Can this be amended?** No; a class change is outside every amendment and requires withdrawal and a new application.
